question: Does ISB reach higher TPR than existing generators at the same FP budget?
arms: ISB at its default point vs yarGen (G_stats DB and stock DB), AutoPYara, AutoYara, frontier LLM given the same candidates, template (no LM)
metrics: Family-macro TPR on held; FP/1k on G_eval and G_ood; cross-family FP; TPR at FP/1k ≤ 0.1

question: Which stage earns the gain: filtering, shortening, ranking, conditions or the gate?
arms: all (capped) → lint → random-k (post-lint, size-matched) → learned, pointwise + type_cover (V1) → learned, set coverage (D12) → + conditions → + FP gate; oracle-sel as ceiling
metrics: Δ TPR and Δ FP/1k per step; paired family bootstrap; Holm

question: What does the full YARA grammar add over hex-only and strings-only rules?
arms: Hex only (AutoPYara-style) vs strings vs + pe module vs + math, filesize, counts vs + .NET metadata
metrics: TPR at fixed FP/1k; strings per rule; slow-rule warnings; scan time

question: Which candidate source carries detection: static strings, byte-CNN spans or both?
arms: Static / classifier / union / analyst-endorsed; byte-CNN binary head vs retrained family head
metrics: TPR and FP/1k per source (V1: classifier spans beat static)

question: Does packer-aware selection cut FP on packed goodware without losing TPR on packed malware?
metrics: FP/1k on natural-packed and self-packed goodware, per packer; TPR on packed vs unpacked malware

question: Do the E1–E2 gains survive labels that are not YARA-derived?
arms: Same deltas on Tier X, the confirmed subset, Tier B and label-free cluster-held evaluation; circularity probe
metrics: Sign and CI of each delta per regime; delta on held samples that public rules for F match vs those they miss
can_start: After G5 and the data cut (P2)

question: How fast does ISB degrade, and which repair rung restores it most cheaply?
arms: Never / periodic / repair ladder (recalibrate → scorer → PEFT → full) / full at each trigger / oracle each window
metrics: TPR and FP/1k per quarterly window of source dates (W3), 2020–2026; FP drift on dated goodware builds; GPU-hours; retrains; forgetting on old families

question: Do calibrated FP budgets hold out of sample?
arms: Calibrate FP/1k at 0, 0.1 and 1 on tune; test on G_eval and G_ood
metrics: Realized vs target FP/1k; TPR at each point

question: Is ISB cheap enough to run on a CPU-only laptop?
arms: ISB stages vs yarGen vs LLM baseline
metrics: p50/p95 latency per sample; peak memory; rules per hour; rule scan cost

question: What does the scorer learn?
arms: Feature importance; PU class-prior sweep; pointwise vs set-coverage selection at matched k
metrics: PR-AUC vs prevalence baseline (V1: 0.171 vs 0.038); gain importances

question: Would analysts deploy the rules?
arms: Blind review of a sample of rules per arm by several analysts
metrics: Would-deploy rate; edits needed; inter-rater agreement
